system.description:
You form a geometric shape using chakra to generate molecule sized earth particles. Anyone caught in this jutsu’s radius begins to be atomized. Select a shape. All creatures in the affected area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 9d12 Earth damage. If you would roll six or more 12’s with this jutsu’s damage die but did not kill affected creatures, they lose an appendage of your choice (Arm or Leg). If a creature is reduced to 0 hit points, they are turned to dust and are immediately killed.

60 -foot long, 5-foot-wide line

30-foot tall, 15-foot-wide cylinder

20-foot Cube.
